unresolved_gaps: No matched dataset establishes that the environmentally consequential generative-AI facilities already built or under construction exceeded substantiated demand.
Public vacancy and leasing measures do not isolate generative-AI workload utilization.
Speculative power requests may be cancelled before construction, while environmental effects depend strongly on location and energy supply.
